rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone is doubtful or not fully convinced.

example.english: I was dubiously unsure, so I didn't dare agree right away.
example.traditional: 半信半疑咁，我都唔敢即刻答應佢。
example.jyutping: bun3 seon3 bun3 ji4 gam3 ngo5 dou1 m4 gam2 zik1 hak1 daap3 jing3 keoi5

rows.note: Use this for a more visibly hesitant or anxiously uncertain manner.

example.english: They stood at the door dubiously, unsure whether to go in.
example.traditional: 佢疑疑惑惑咁企喺門口，唔知應唔應該入去。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ji4 ji4 waak6 waak6 gam3 kei5 hai2 mun4 hau2 m4 zi1 jing1 m4 jing1 goi1 jap6 heoi3

rows.note: Use this when an action, statement, or manner seems suspicious or questionable rather than when someone is merely uncertain.

example.english: They looked around dubiously and then sneaked off.
example.traditional: 佢可疑咁四圍望，跟住偷偷咁走咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ho2 ji4 gam3 sei3 wai4 mong6 gan1 zyu6 tau1 tau1 gam3 zau2 zo2
